column3: The verse is difficult; NKJV renders “the oracle” as “his utterance” and “the utterance of the man” as “This man declared.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural form “holy ones” is rendered “the Holy One.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “His name… His Son’s name.”
Close to the Hebrew; צְרוּפָה (“refined”) is rendered “pure,” and “take refuge” “put their trust.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seize the name” is rendered “profane the name.”
Close to the Hebrew; “jaw teeth” is rendered “fangs.”
Close to the Hebrew; שְׁאוֹל (“Sheol”) is rendered “The grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ravens of the wadi” is rendered “The ravens of the valley.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּעַלְמָה (“with a young woman”) is rendered “with a virgin.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִּי־ תִירַשׁ (“displaces”) is rendered “who succeeds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “dividing” is rendered “advance in ranks.”
Close to the Hebrew; שְׂמָמִית (“a lizard”) is rendered “The spider.”
